describe:
Leave By, in the orange colours.
You can change: "Train departs": time of day, starts at 17:45; "Minutes to the station": number, starts at 50; "Spare minutes": number, starts at 15.
Works out:
- leave is train minus the result of travel plus spare times 1 minute.
- wait is the result of the result of the hour of leave times 60 plus the minute of leave minus the result of the hour of now times 60 plus the minute of now leaves over when divided by 1440.
Shows:
- a box to fill in train.
- a box to fill in travel.
- a box to fill in spare.
- text: "Leave home at".
- text: leave.
- text: "That is in", wait divided by 60 rounded down, "h", wait leaves over when divided by 60, "min".

Handover list, in the teal colours.
Keeps:
- hitem: what: text; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: note, starting at "".
Shows:
- a bar with "Handover list" and a button that opens a form to add a hitem.
- how many hitem entries where done is yes out of the larger of how many hitem entries and 1 with a progress bar, labelled "items ticked".
- for each hitem sorted by at:
  - a group; a tap opens the hitem for editing; a swipe removes the hitem, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the hitem.
    - text: the what of the hitem.
- a box to fill in note, labelled "Note for the next person".
- a button "Reset for next week"; a tap sets the done of the hitem to no for every hitem.
needs: free text note for the next person

describe:
Money Lent, in the pink colours.
Keeps:
- loan: who: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- repay: loan: a loan; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- lent is the total amount of loan.
- back is the total amount of repay.
Shows:
- a bar with "Money Lent" and a button that opens a form to add a loan.
- a card with a big number lent minus back, labelled "still owed to me", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card with a big number back, labelled "paid back so far", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each loan sorted by at:
  - a group; a tap opens the loan for editing; a swipe removes the loan, with undo:
    - text: the who of the loan.
    - text: the amount of the loan minus the total amount of the loan's repay entries.
    - the total amount of the loan's repay entries out of the amount of the loan with a progress bar, labelled "paid back".
    - a button "+500"; a tap adds a repay with loan set to the loan, amount set to 500.
    - a button "+1000"; a tap adds a repay with loan set to the loan, amount set to 1000.
    - a button "Paid in full"; a tap adds a repay with loan set to the loan, amount set to the amount of the loan minus the total amount of the loan's repay entries.
- a card titled "Payments received" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: record money lent with the person and amount
totals still owed and paid back

Umrah shopping, in the purple colours.

- for each buy sorted by at:

    - text: the qty of the buy, "x", the sar of the buy, "SAR".
    - text: the sar of the buy times the qty of the buy times rate rounded.
needs: add item with riyal price and count

tick each of six checks per review
count of checks done per review

bill from minutes and price per minute

Step Goal, in the teal colours.
Keeps:
- walk: steps: number, 1 to 100000. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

Works out:

describe:
Week Hours, in the green colours.
You can change: "Weekly target (hours)": number, starts at 40.
Works out:
- left days is the larger of 6 minus the weekday number of today and 0.
- need is the larger of target minus done and 0.
Remembers while you use it: done, starting at 18.5.
Shows:
- a box to fill in target.
- a box to fill in done, labelled "Hours done so far".
- a card with a big number done, labelled "hours done of" target, with a ring toward target when there is one.
- if need is 0:
  - text: "Target reached. Enjoy the rest of the week.".
- otherwise:
  - if left days is 0:
    - text: "No work days left this week.".
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Work", need divided by left days times 10 rounded divided by 10, "hours a day for", the plural of left days.
    - text: "Still", need, "hours to go".

Grocery, in the yellow colours.
Keeps:
- buy: item: text; amount: money; cat: one of Staples, Dairy, Meat, Veg, Fruit, Other, starts at Staples. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "People eating": number, starts at 6; "Budget per head": money, starts at 6000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of buy this month.
- each head is spent divided by the larger of heads and 1.
Shows:
- a bar with "Grocery" and a button that opens a form to add a buy.
- each head rounded out of plan with a progress bar, labelled "per head this month".
- a card with a big number spent, labelled "spent by the whole house this month", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Where it goes" with "this month" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Days left" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of buy this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add a grocery item with category and amount

describe:
Drawer Count, in the pink colours.
Works out:
- total is n1 times 1000 plus n2 times 500 plus n3 times 100 plus n4 times 50 plus n5 times 20 plus n6 times 10.
Remembers while you use it: n1, starting at 0; n2, starting at 0; n3, starting at 0; n4, starting at 0; n5, starting at 0; n6, starting at 0; book, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - a box to fill in n1, labelled "1000 notes".
  - a box to fill in n2, labelled "500 notes".
  - a box to fill in n3, labelled "100 notes".
  - a box to fill in n4, labelled "50 notes".
  - a box to fill in n5, labelled "20 notes".
  - a box to fill in n6, labelled "10 notes".
- a card with a big number total, labelled "in the drawer", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a box to fill in book, labelled "Sales book says".
- if book is more than 0:
  - if total is at least book:
    - text: "Extra", total minus book.
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Short", book minus total.

Shop Accounts, in the green colours.
Keeps:
- acct: kind: one of Sales, Stock, Rent, Wages, Utilities, Other, starts at Sales; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- inc is the total amount of acct in the month of m where kind is Sales.
- outg is the total amount of acct in the month of m minus inc.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Shop Accounts" and a button that opens a form to add a acct.
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- a card with a big number inc minus outg, labelled "profit, sales" inc ", costs" outg, with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- text: "Costs are", outg times 100 divided by the larger of inc and 1 rounded, "% of sales".
- a card titled "Where the costs went" with the month of m on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of acct in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: record sales, stock, rent, wages and utilities
costs as a share of sales

describe:
Floor split, in the purple colours.
Works out:
- units is up plus down.
- rate is the result of bill minus fixed divided by the larger of units and 1.
- up pay is up times rate plus fixed divided by 2.
- down pay is down times rate plus fixed divided by 2.
Remembers while you use it: up, starting at 0; down, starting at 0; bill, starting at 0; fixed, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a card titled "Bill" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Sub meters units" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- if units is 0 or bill is 0:
  - text: "Enter both meters and the bill to split it.".
- otherwise:
  - a card with a big number rate times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "per unit after fixed charges", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a card with a big number up pay rounded, labelled "upstairs pays", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a card with a big number down pay rounded, labelled "downstairs pays", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a drawing made of rectangles.

Homework Due, in the purple colours.
Keeps:
- work: kid: text; subject: text; due: date; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- late is how many work entries where done is no and due is less than today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Homework Due" and a button that opens a form to add a work.
- a card with a big number how many work entries where done is no, labelled "pieces still due ·" late "late", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Open per child" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- for each group of work entries where done is no by kid:
  - text: the key of the group.
  - for each the group:
    - a group; a tap opens the g for editing; a swipe removes the g, with undo:
      - a tick box for the done of the g.
      - text: the subject of the g.
      - text: the due of the g.
needs: add homework with child, subject and due date
count of open and late pieces
bars of open work per child

describe:
Error budget, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- day: "Total requests": number, at least 0; "Failed requests": number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "SLO (%)": number, 90 to 100, starts at 99.5.
Works out:
- budget is the total total of day this month times the result of 100 minus slo divided by 100 rounded.
- burnt is the total failed of day this month.
Shows:
- a bar with "Error budget" and a button that opens a form to add a day.
- a card with a big number the larger of budget minus burnt and 0, labelled "failures left of" budget, with a ring toward budget when there is one.
- if burnt is more than budget:
  - text: "Budget is gone: freeze risky releases.".
- a card titled "Failed requests" with "last 14 days" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of day by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add daily total and failed requests

describe:
Solar size, in the slate colours.
You can change: "Price per kW": money, starts at 150000.
Works out:
- w is 450 when watt is W450, otherwise 550 when watt is W550, otherwise 600.
- kw is units divided by the larger of sun times 30 times 0.8 and 1.
- panels is kw times 1000 divided by w rounded down plus 1 when kw times 1000 divided by w is more than kw times 1000 divided by w rounded down, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: units, starting at 600; sun, starting at 5; watt, starting at W550.
Shows:
- a card titled "Your house" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number kw times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "kW system", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: panels, labelled "panels of" w "W".
- a big number: panels times 28, labelled "sq ft of roof".
- text: "Rough price", kw times per kw rounded.
- text: "Includes 20% loss for dust, heat and wiring.".
needs: number of panels and roof area

- milk is litres times 30.
Remembers while you use it: feed, starting at 90000; fodder, starting at 30000; labour, starting at 20000; vet, starting at 5000; litres, starting at 60; rate, starting at 190.

- a card titled "Milk" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number milk times rate minus cost rounded, labelled "profit a month", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: cost divided by the highest of 1 over the milk rounded, labelled "cost of one litre".
- a big number: milk times rate rounded, labelled "milk income".
- if cost divided by the larger of milk and 1 is more than rate:
  - text: "You lose money on each litre at this rate.".

litres a day and milk rate

describe:
Solar loan, in the ink colours.
Works out:
- r is rate divided by 1200.
- n is years times 12.
- emi is loan divided by the larger of n and 1 when r is 0, otherwise loan times r times the pow of 1 plus r divided by the result of the pow of 1 plus r minus 1.
Remembers while you use it: loan, starting at 800000; rate, starting at 14; years, starting at 5; saved, starting at 25000.
Shows:
- a card titled "Loan" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number emi rounded, labelled "monthly installment", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: emi times n rounded, labelled "paid back in all".
- a big number: emi times n minus loan rounded, labelled "extra for the loan".
- if saved is at least emi:
  - text: "The bill you save covers the installment, with", saved minus emi rounded, "left over each month.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "You pay", emi minus saved rounded, "more each month than you save.".

describe:
Age Gap, in the purple colours.
You can change: "Older person born": date, starts at 1994-03-12; "Younger person born": date, starts at 1998-09-30.
Works out:
- mths is the result of the year of younger minus the year of older times 12 plus the month of younger minus the month of older minus 1 when the day of the month of younger is less than the day of the month of older, otherwise 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in older.
- a box to fill in younger.
- if younger is less than older:
  - text: "The second date must be later than the first.".
- otherwise:
  - a card with a big number mths divided by 12 rounded down, labelled "years," mths % 12 "months and" younger - addmonthsolder, mths "days", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - text: "In total", younger minus older, "days apart".
needs: difference in years months and days

describe:
Bake Sale, in the orange colours.
Keeps:
- sale: item: one of Cookie, Brownie, Cupcake, Lemonade, starts at Cookie; price: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Fundraising target": money, starts at 20000.
Shows:
- a card with a big number the total price of sale, labelled "raised of" target, with a ring toward target when there is one.
- a grid of 2 columns:
  - a button "Cookie 100"; a tap adds a sale with item set to Cookie, price set to 100.
  - a button "Brownie 150"; a tap adds a sale with item set to Brownie, price set to 150.
  - a button "Cupcake 200"; a tap adds a sale with item set to Cupcake, price set to 200.
  - a button "Lemonade 80"; a tap adds a sale with item set to Lemonade, price set to 80.
- a button "Undo last sale"; a tap removes the latest sale entries, with undo.
- a card titled "Sold so far" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.

Iftar Boxes, in the pink colours.
Keeps:
- packed: boxes: number, 1 to 500. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Box goal": number, starts at 500; "Hand out date": date, starts at 2027-03-10.
Works out:
- left is the larger of target minus the total boxes of packed and 0.
- per day is left divided by the larger of deadline minus today and 1 rounded.
Shows:
- a card with a big number the total boxes of packed, labelled "boxes packed of" target, with a ring toward target when there is one.
- one-tap buttons that add a packed with boxes set to each of 10, 25, 50.
- text: "Still to pack", left, "- about", per day, "a day".
- a card titled "Packed per day" with "last 7 days" on the right, holding the lines under it.
Reminder "Time to start packing iftar boxes" at 15:00 every day.
needs: quick buttons to add packed boxes
boxes needed per day to finish on time
chart of boxes packed per day

describe:
Before the Date, in the grey colours.
Keeps:
- event: what: text; day: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Before the Date" and a button that opens a form to add a event.
- a card with a big number how many event entries where day is at least today and day is at most today plus 7, labelled "dates in the next 7 days", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each event where day is at least today sorted by day:
  - a group; a tap opens the event for editing; a swipe removes the event, with undo:
    - text: the what of the event.
    - text: the day of the event.
    - text: "Today" when the day of the event is today, otherwise the plural of the day of the event minus today.
- a card titled "Already passed" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
Reminder "Something is due tomorrow" on each day of the event entries, 24 hours before at 9:00.
Reminder "Something is due today" on each day of the event entries.
needs: add a bill, birthday or appointment with a date
reminder the day before and on the day

describe:
Mess Counter, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- plate: meal: one of Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, starts at Lunch. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Plates we can serve a day": number, starts at 120.
Shows:
- how many plate entries today out of seats with a progress bar, labelled "plates served today".
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - for each choice of the meal of the plate:
    - text: the choice.
    - text: how many plate entries today where meal is the choice.
    - a button "+1"; a tap adds a plate with meal set to the choice.
    - a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest plate entries today where meal is the choice, with undo.
- a card titled "Last 7 days" with "total plates" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: counter with plus one for each meal
undo the last plate of a meal

describe:
Protein, in the red colours.
You can change: "Body weight (kg)": number, 30 to 200, starts at 75.
Works out:
- per kg is 2 when aim is Build, otherwise 1.6 when aim is Keep, otherwise 2.2.
- total is kg times per kg rounded.
Remembers while you use it: aim, starting at Build; meals, starting at 4.
Shows:
- a box to fill in kg.
- a choice of aim.
- a card with a big number total, labelled "g of protein a day " per_kg "g per kg", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Split across meals" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: goal chips build keep or cut

describe:
Fryer Oil, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- fry: batches: number, 1 to 10, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- change: litres: number, 1 to 60, starts at 15; cost: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- since change is how many fry entries when how many change entries is 0, otherwise how many fry entries where at is at least a value.
Shows:
- a card with a big number since change, labelled "batches since the last oil change", with a ring toward 50 when there is one.
- if since change is at least 50:
  - text: "Time to change the oil.".
- a button "Count a batch"; a tap adds a fry.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest fry entries today, with undo.
- a form to add a change.
- a card titled "Oil spend" with "this month" sumchange.cost month on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: tap to count a fry batch
log an oil change with litres and cost
batches since the last oil change

describe:
Dear Diary, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- page: title: text, optional; mood: one of Happy, Calm, Tired, Sad, Angry, starts at Calm; body: long text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Dear Diary" and a button that opens a form to add a page.
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- a card with a big number how many page entries in the month of m, labelled "pages in" monthnamem, with a ring toward the number of days in the month of m when there is one.
- a grid of the days in the month of m, each coloured by how many page entries on that day, with its day of the month.
- a card titled "Moods" with "this month" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of page in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: write a diary page with title, mood and text
grid showing which days have a page
list of pages grouped by day

describe:
Till and Stock, in the yellow colours.
Keeps:
- product: name: text; price: money; stock: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- sale: product: a product; qty: number, 1 to 999, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- takings is the sum of its qty times its product price over the sale today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Till and Stock" and a button that opens a form to add a product.
- a card with a big number takings, labelled "taken today from" pluralcountsale today, "sale", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each product sorted by stock:
  - a group; a tap opens the product for editing; a swipe removes the product, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product.
    - text: the price of the product, "each,", the stock of the product, "left".
    - if the stock of the product is more than 0:
      - a button "Sell 1"; a tap adds a sale with product set to the product, then sets the stock of the product to the stock of the product minus 1.
    - otherwise:
      - text: "Sold out".
- a card titled "Best sellers" with "units" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Takings" with "last 7 days" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: Sell 1 button that records a sale and lowers stock

describe:
Dollar Payout, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- payout: usd: money; got: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- gotlocal is the larger of dollars times rate times the result of 1 minus fee divided by 100 minus flat and 0.
Remembers while you use it: dollars, starting at 0; rate, starting at 280; fee, starting at 1.5; flat, starting at 200.
Shows:
- a box to fill in dollars, labelled "Invoice in dollars".
- a box to fill in rate, labelled "Bank rate".
- a box to fill in fee, labelled "Fee %".
- a box to fill in flat, labelled "Flat local fee".
- if dollars is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number gotlocal rounded, labelled "arrives in your account", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a button "Save payout"; a tap adds a payout with usd set to dollars, got set to gotlocal.
- a card titled "Past payouts" with the total got of payout on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: conversion fee percent and flat fee

describe:
Family Recipes, in the blue colours.
Keeps:
- recipe: name: text; cook: text, optional; mins: number, 5 to 300, starts at 30. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- ingr: recipe: a recipe; item: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- need: what: text; got: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Family Recipes" and a button that opens a form to add a recipe.
- for each recipe sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the recipe for editing; a swipe removes the recipe, with undo:
    - text: the name of the recipe.
    - text: the cook of the recipe.
    - for each the recipe's ingr:
      - text: the item of the ingr.
      - a button "+ list"; a tap adds a need with what set to the item of the ingr.
- a card titled "Shopping list" with "to buy:" countneed where got = no on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a form to add a ingr.
needs: save family recipes with who cooks them
tap plus list to put an ingredient on the shopping list

describe:
Visitors, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- visit: name: text; host: text; tin: time of day; tout: time of day. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Visitors" and a button that opens a form to add a visit.
- a card with a big number how many visit entries today, labelled "visitors today", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card with a big number the highest of mins of the visit over the visit this week, labelled "longest visit this week, min", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each visit, first 15:
  - a group; a tap opens the visit for editing; a swipe removes the visit, with undo:
    - text: the name of the visit.
    - text: "to see", the host of the visit.
    - text: the result of the result of the tout of the visit minus the tin of the visit divided by 1 minute, "min".
    - text: the tin of the visit, "to", the tout of the visit.
needs: log a visitor with host, time in and time out

describe:
Each Pays, in the slate colours.
You can change: "Service charge %": number, starts at 5.
Works out:
- total is bill times the result of 1 plus service divided by 100.
Remembers while you use it: bill, starting at 0; people, starting at 4.
Shows:
- a box to fill in bill, labelled "Bill total".
- a button "-"; a tap sets people to the larger of people minus 1 and 1.
- text: "People", people.
- a button "+"; a tap sets people to people plus 1.
- if bill is more than 0:
  - text: total divided by people rounded.
  - text: "each, with", service, "% service included".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the total bill to split it.".
needs: change the number of people with plus and minus
shows the amount each person pays

describe:
Move In Rent, in the slate colours.
Works out:
- dim is the number of days in the month of moved.
- stay is dim minus the day of the month of moved plus 1.
- first is rent times stay divided by dim.
Remembers while you use it: moved, starting at today; rent, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in moved, labelled "Move in date".
- a box to fill in rent, labelled "Monthly rent".
- if rent is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number first plus rent times 2 rounded, labelled "to pay on day one", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a big number: first rounded, labelled "rent for" pluralstay, "day".
  - a big number: rent times 2, labelled "deposit".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the monthly rent to see the first payment.".
needs: days stayed in the first month
total to pay on day one

describe:
Calorie Budget, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- meal: what: text; kcal: number, 0 to 3000; slot: one of Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack, starts at Lunch. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily calories": number, starts at 1800.
Works out:
- eaten is the total kcal of meal today.
Shows:
- a bar with "Calorie Budget" and a button that opens a form to add a meal.
- a card with a big number eaten, labelled "kcal eaten of" daily, with a ring toward daily when there is one.
- if eaten is more than daily:
  - text: "Over by", eaten minus daily, "kcal".
- otherwise:
  - text: daily minus eaten, "kcal left today".
- a card titled "By meal" with "today" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Last 7 days" with "under the limit on" countdays last 7 days, summeal.kcal on it > 0 and summeal.kcal on it <= daily "days" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of meal today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add food with calories and meal
days under the limit this week

describe:
Saved Recipes, in the grey colours.
Keeps:
- recipe: name: text; "Where it came from": text, optional; rating: number, 1 to 5, starts at 3; tried: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: t, starting at To try.
Shows:
- a bar with "Saved Recipes" and a button that opens a form to add a recipe.
- a card with a big number how many recipe entries where tried is yes, labelled "tried of" countrecipe "saved", with a ring toward how many recipe entries when there is one.
- a choice of t.
- if t is Tried:
  - for each recipe where tried is yes sorted by rating, highest first:
    - a group; a tap opens the recipe for editing; a swipe removes the recipe, with undo:
      - text: the name of the recipe.
      - text: the from of the recipe.
      - text: "Rating", the rating of the recipe, "of 5".
- otherwise:
  - for each recipe where tried is no sorted by name:
    - a group; a tap opens the recipe for editing; a swipe removes the recipe, with undo:
      - text: the name of the recipe.
      - text: the from of the recipe.
      - a tick box for the tried of the recipe.
needs: save a recipe with where it came from and a rating
switch between to try and tried

describe:
Water Need, in the teal colours.
Works out:
- ml is kg times 33 plus ex times 12 plus 500 when hot, otherwise 0.
- glasses is ml divided by 250 rounded.
Remembers while you use it: kg, starting at 65; ex, starting at 30; hot.
Shows:
- a card titled "Your day" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number ml divided by 100 rounded divided by 10, labelled "litres of water today", with a ring toward 4 when there is one.
- text: "About", glasses, "glasses of 250 ml".
- text: "Your base need is", kg times 33 rounded, "ml. Exercise adds", ex times 12, "ml.".

Trip Ready, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- pack: what: text; packed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- spend: what: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Trip budget": money, starts at 50000; "Leaving on": date, starts at 2026-12-24.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of spend.
Shows:
- a bar with "Trip Ready" and a button that opens a form to add a pack.
- a card with a big number the larger of leave minus today and 0, labelled "days until you leave", with a ring toward 30 when there is one.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "over budget" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "spent of budget".
- if spent is more than budget:
  - text: "Over by", spent minus budget.
- a card titled "Packing" with "ticked:" countpack where packed = yes "of" countpack on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a form to add a spend.
needs: spending log with a progress bar against the budget

describe:
Bakery, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- order: name: text; item: text; qty: number, 1 to 100, starts at 1; price: money; pick: time of day; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Bakery" and a button that opens a form to add a order.
- a card with a big number the sum of its qty times its price over the order today, labelled "cash expected today", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card with a big number how many order entries today where done is no and the hour of pick is at least the hour of now, labelled "pickups still to come", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each order today sorted by pick:
  - a group; a tap opens the order for editing; a swipe removes the order, with undo:
    - text: the pick of the order.
    - text: the name of the order, the item of the order, "x", the qty of the order.
    - text: the qty of the order times the price of the order.
    - a tick box for the done of the order.
needs: add an order with name, item, quantity, price and pickup time

describe:
House Hub, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- cash: what: text; amount: money; kind: one of In, Out, starts at Out. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- item: what: text; got: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- job: kid: text; what: text; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Money":
  - a bar with "House Money" and a button that opens a form to add a cash.
  - a card with a big number the total amount of cash where kind is In minus the total amount of cash where kind is Out, labelled "left, spent this month" sumcash.amount month where kind = Out, with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a bar chart of the total amount of cash on that day where kind is Out for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of cash, first 6; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a screen "List":
  - a bar with "Shared list" and a button that opens a form to add a item.
  - for each item sorted by got:
    - a group; a tap opens the item for editing; a swipe removes the item, with undo:
      - a tick box for the got of the item.
      - text: the what of the item.
- a screen "Kids":
  - a bar with "Jobs" and a button that opens a form to add a job.
  - a card titled "Jobs done" with "per child" on the right, holding the lines under it.
  - for each job sorted by done:
    - a group; a tap opens the job for editing; a swipe removes the job, with undo:
      - a tick box for the done of the job.
      - text: the kid of the job.
      - text: the what of the job.
needs: house money in and out with what is left
shared list anyone can add to
jobs for the children with ticks
share of jobs done per child

describe:
Skills, in the purple colours.
Keeps:
- member: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- skill: member: a member; tech: text; level: number, 1 to 4, starts at 2. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Skill matrix" and a button that opens a form to add a member.
- for each group of skill entries by tech:
  - text: its key.
  - text: "best level", the highest level of the group.
  - if how many the group is 1:
    - text: "bus factor 1".
  - otherwise:
    - text: how many the group, "people".
- a card titled "Rate someone" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: rate a person on a tech from 1 to 4
